scope: Read-only metadata and physical-byte inspection; no compiler execution, no proof upgrade.

wrapper.retention: Live dependency of the frozen run; preserve the old raw compiler-bin directory.

implementation_boundary.c_lowering.identity: Aggregate digest incorporates stdlib_provenance.runtime_identity(tool), in addition to source/checker identities.
runtime_identity_success: resolved effective cc1 driver path and binary SHA256
command executable wrapper path and SHA256
complete canonical libc++ and clang-resource header-tree SHA256
implementation_boundary.runtime_identity_failure: Explicit unavailable reason is incorporated instead when context resolution fails.
implementation_boundary.record_boundary: For these non-standard-substitution units, the record retains only the aggregate lowering digest and wrapper clang digest. It does not decompose the runtime components or expose which runtime_identity branch supplied that aggregate. Current physical reads alone do not reconstruct historical runtime selection.
implementation_boundary.link_boundary: Run.sh configures LIBRARY_PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH for LLVM libc++ and GCC13. runtime_identity does not hash native link inputs or their transitive shared objects. WP source parsing is a frontend/header boundary.

next: Capture decomposed current-source runtime/toolchain identity during the coordinated final preflight; rerun every final acceptance profile on reviewed composed source.
